description: ​I am a high school student participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Interested in space science, technology, and problem-solving. This is a solo team focused on completing the selected challenge independently.
summary: ALSEP Project is an interactive educational website dedicated to exploring the historical and scientific significance of the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP) left behind the Moon. Designed specifically for school-age space enthusiasts, this project breaks down complex space heritage data into engaging stories, highlighting how these discarded instruments laid the crucial groundwork for modern lunar science and exploration
details:
what: An interactive educational platform about the apollo lunar surface experiments package (ALSEP) historic scientific instruments left on the moon by Apollo astronouts to study its interior and environtment.

how: built as an interactive website and 7-page PDF demo that guides users through Apollo mission timelines, scientific instruments (like seismometers and heat flow probes), landing sites, and real seismic discoveries.

why: to ensure these abandoned lunar artifacts are not forgotten, highlighting how ALSEP's data laid the foundation for modern lunar science.
dataRefs: NASA - ALSEP: Scientific Station on the Moon
